delivery.feedback: Add severity to line one: how many are trapped, whether anyone is hurt, and the heat. Cut the filler lines and aim for about 70 words.

feedback: Your message says the number trapped and injuries are not stated, but the caller said four people are trapped and nobody is hurt. Put that in line one, along with the heat and the panicking woman.
The name 'Douglas Emmett' and the phone 555-085-6585 are not in the building record, so you invented them. Give the crew only verified contacts. Say 'property manager, no name or number on file'.

The caller said they got on at floor 4 and the car stopped between floors. 'Stopped at floor 4' is wrong. Say it is between floors, and that the car number is unknown. Drop the floor 4 tenant list, which doesn't help a rescue.
